boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Record the no-match, use the live activation and exact committed baton as authority, and infer nothing from registry silence.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never turn an absent memory hit into identity, continuity, or completion evidence.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the lookup zero continuity credit and retain the live request as the controlling authority.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only memory registry inspection only; no memory file is changed by the lookup.
preferred_methods.title: Treat exact-current memory no-match as absence, not continuity
trigger_preconditions: The live activation refers to a phase newer than the current memory registry entries.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run anchor, tracked-diff, staged-diff, and untracked probes independently with native exit-code capture.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not combine status, worktree listing, ancestry, and remote proof in one short startup wrapper.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the timeout, give it no cleanliness credit, and use only the bounded recovery results.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only Git recovery only; it performs no branch or file mutation.
preferred_methods.title: Split broad worktree startup probes into bounded native checks
trigger_preconditions: A large Windows worktree needs anchor, diff, index, and untracked checks before mutation.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Set console output and Python I/O encoding to UTF-8 before reading or emitting the exact text.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 before every Unicode-emitting phase command, builder, validator, and source diagnostic.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the mojibake witness, leave the Git blob unchanged, and rerun only the diagnostic with UTF-8 pinned.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Encoding recovery only; it confers no Māori-language or Māori-authority review.
preferred_methods.title: Pin UTF-8 before Unicode-bearing diagnostics
trigger_preconditions: A diagnostic may emit Māori or other non-ASCII text on Windows PowerShell.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Query Git's indexed path list once, then apply one exact-name alternation and adjudicate only returned paths.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not launch one full historical content scan per proposed package name.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the timeout, create no package from the failed scan, and use only indexed-path results.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Indexed filename evidence only; content semantics still require manual proposal review.
preferred_methods.title: Use one indexed-path collision audit instead of repeated full scans
trigger_preconditions: Many proposed family-current package names require an exact pre-build collision check.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Filter the Git indexed-path list, report exact matching filenames, and inspect content only for the small returned set.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not use whole-body traversal for a package-name collision question that the index can answer.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed recovery, give it no novelty credit, and rely only on the indexed-path pass.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Exact indexed filenames only; absence of a path match is not proof of semantic novelty.
preferred_methods.title: Keep exact-name collision checks in the indexed path domain
trigger_preconditions: Exact family-current skill and runner names need collision evidence across a very large historical repository.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Keep only definitions, x1 builder, and x1 tests in the owner worktree until x1 is committed, pushed, and remote-equal.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not materialize x2 runtime, evidence, closeout, or outcome tests before the x1 publication gate.
preferred_methods.rollback: Remove only the exact owner-created untracked placeholders and recreate them from the frozen x1 commit after publication.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Owner-created untracked placeholders only; inherited and user material remains untouched.
preferred_methods.title: Keep x2 scaffolding absent from the x1 worktree surface
trigger_preconditions: A successor phase adapts a prior phase's multi-stage builder family before x1 is committed.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Set the repository working directory explicitly or verify exact absolute owner-worktree paths before using relative probes.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Every post-copy relative probe declares its repository working directory.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the failed verification zero credit, then inspect only the exact intended files read-only.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local path verification only; no sibling or user path mutation.
preferred_methods.title: Bind post-copy verification to the exact repository root
trigger_preconditions: A bounded copy or generation step is followed by relative-path verification.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Pass the full alternation as one single-quoted PowerShell literal.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use single-quoted literals for read-only search patterns that contain JSON quote characters.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure with zero credit; no repository rollback is required.
preferred_methods.title: Quote JSON-like ripgrep alternations as PowerShell literals
trigger_preconditions: A read-only ripgrep alternation contains JSON-like quotes under Windows PowerShell 5.1.
